proofs.evidence: statements generate only for own paid payout items (Phase20HEarningsApiTest); query prefill carries an own ULID that the server re-validates; malformed references are dropped (Ui14PersonnelPages.spec.ts)
no current plan -> 'No current plan' model label and the Compensation Terms empty state; no earnings -> 'No earnings have been recorded yet.'

proofs.claim: Unknown model never removes contract navigation
proofs.evidence: AppShell and PersonnelEarningsNav hide Commission/Salary only when the server positively reports a current, non-conflicting plan that excludes them (UI14-NAV-001); the ui-07 contract case renders every Personnel entry without earnings data; with no plan the direct routes state that no current compensation plan is on file
